caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed frame shown in perspective, featuring four turned bedposts, each with a rounded finial on top. The headboard is highly decorative, with two horizontal railings; both are adorned with curving, scalloped shapes accentuated by a medium periwinkle blue color, contrasting the brownish tones of the wooden frame. The side and foot rails of the bed are rendered in a light brown shade with a visible grain texture, indicative of wood. The bed is outlined in white, giving it a highlighted appearance against the tan background. The drawing is composed with the bed slightly angled to show both its length and width. At the lower left, the name “RICHARD REIMER” is hand-written in green capital letters. The background is plain, light brown with a slightly mottled texture and some small marks or stains near the bottom.
title: Bed
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
